activities.title: Welcome Back: Build a Full Description
activities.summary: Students use one keyed sketch board to review garment, detail, palette, silhouette, and fabric language before they build full sketch descriptions this week.

en.title: Welcome Back: Build a Full Description
en.summary: Look at the sketch board and choose the best answer for each quick question.
en.instructions: Look at the keyed sketch board first. Choose the correct answer for each short question about the garment, one detail, the color palette, the silhouette, and a likely fabric.
success_criteria: I can notice key visual clues on one sketch board.
I can review garment, detail, and color words.
I can prepare for a full sketch description.

pt.title: Bem-vindo de volta: construa uma descricao completa
pt.summary: Observe o painel do croqui e escolha a melhor resposta para cada pergunta rapida.
pt.instructions: Observe primeiro o painel do croqui com chaves visiveis. Escolha a resposta correta para cada pergunta curta sobre a roupa, um detalhe, a paleta de cores, a silhueta e um tecido provavel.
success_criteria: Eu consigo perceber pistas visuais importantes em um painel de croqui.
Eu consigo revisar palavras de roupa, detalhe e cor.
Eu consigo me preparar para uma descricao completa do croqui.

activities.teacher_instructions: Keep the opener fast and visual. Every answer should come from visible clues on the keyed board.

input.prompt_en: Choose the best review answer for each sketch question.
input.prompt_pt: Escolha a melhor resposta de revisao para cada pergunta sobre o croqui.

items.label_en: Which garment is the main piece on the board?
items.label_pt: Qual roupa e a peca principal no painel?

items.label_en: Which visible detail is easy to see?
items.label_pt: Qual detalhe visivel e facil de ver?

items.label_en: Which phrase best describes the color palette?
items.label_pt: Qual expressao descreve melhor a paleta de cores?

items.label_en: Which silhouette fits the sketch best?
items.label_pt: Qual silhueta combina melhor com o croqui?

items.label_en: Which fabric is the best visual guess?
items.label_pt: Qual tecido e a melhor pista visual?

steps.title: Look at the keyed board
steps.student_action_en: Look at the sketch board before you answer.
steps.student_action_pt: Observe o painel do croqui antes de responder.
steps.teacher_action: Remind students to use only visible clues.

steps.title: Choose the quick answers
steps.student_action_en: Choose the correct answer for each short question.
steps.student_action_pt: Escolha a resposta correta para cada pergunta curta.
steps.teacher_action: Keep the pace quick and supportive.

expected_output.description_en: Five app-checked selections about one keyed fashion sketch.
expected_output.description_pt: Cinco selecoes verificadas pelo app sobre um croqui de moda com chaves visiveis.

completion_criteria_en: The student answers all five opener items.
The student identifies garment, detail, color, and silhouette language from visible clues.
The student uses a likely fabric answer that is supported by the image.
completion_criteria_pt: O aluno responde os cinco itens iniciais.
O aluno identifica linguagem de roupa, detalhe, cor e silhueta a partir de pistas visiveis.
O aluno usa uma resposta de tecido provavel apoiada pela imagem.
checklist_en: I looked at the board first.
I answered all five items.
I used visible clues for the fabric answer.
checklist_pt: Eu observei o painel primeiro.
Eu respondi os cinco itens.
Eu usei pistas visiveis para a resposta sobre tecido.
assessment.model_response_en: a jacket, two pockets, neutral and dark, straight, denim
assessment.model_response_pt: a jacket, two pockets, neutral and dark, straight, denim
common_errors: Choosing a bright palette when the colors are dark and neutral.
Guessing a fabric that is not visually supported.
feedback_prompts_en: Look again. Which answer matches the visible clue on the board?
feedback_prompts_pt: Observe novamente. Qual resposta combina com a pista visivel no painel?

support: Let students name one clue in Portuguese before choosing the English answer.
challenge: Ask stronger learners to say one full sentence after each answer.

extension_options: Say one more sentence about the sketch after the opener.
activities.notes_for_app_design: Render one static opener board with five single-choice items. Keep all options visible and save selections only.

activities.title: Sketch Description Vocabulary Review
activities.summary: Students review mixed Week 10 vocabulary by matching English terms to Portuguese support and sorting the same terms into sketch-description categories.

en.title: Sketch Description Vocabulary Review
en.summary: Match the words and sort them into the correct category.
en.instructions: Match the English words to the Portuguese support words. Then sort the same words into figure, garment, detail, color, fabric, and design-comment groups.
success_criteria: I can connect English fashion words to Portuguese support.
I can sort sketch-description words by category.
I can prepare for reading, listening, and writing this week.
sentence_frames: This word is in the ___ group.

pt.title: Revisao de vocabulario para descrever croquis
pt.summary: Relacione as palavras e organize-as na categoria correta.
pt.instructions: Relacione as palavras em ingles ao apoio em portugues. Depois organize as mesmas palavras nos grupos de figura, roupa, detalhe, cor, tecido e comentario de design.
success_criteria: Eu consigo ligar palavras de moda em ingles ao apoio em portugues.
Eu consigo organizar palavras de descricao de croqui por categoria.
Eu consigo me preparar para leitura, escuta e escrita nesta semana.
sentence_frames: This word is in the ___ group.

activities.teacher_instructions: Keep the main saved output as matching and sorting only. Do not turn this into a typing task.

input.prompt_en: Match the words and sort them into the correct category groups.
input.prompt_pt: Relacione as palavras e organize-as nos grupos corretos.

items.label_en: Match the English words to Portuguese support.
items.label_pt: Relacione as palavras em ingles ao apoio em portugues.

items.label_en: Sort the words into the correct groups.
items.label_pt: Organize as palavras nos grupos corretos.

steps.title: Match the support words
steps.student_action_en: Match the English words to the Portuguese support words.
steps.student_action_pt: Relacione as palavras em ingles ao apoio em portugues.
steps.teacher_action: Remind students that the target production stays in English.

steps.title: Sort the words
steps.student_action_en: Sort the same words into the correct category groups.
steps.student_action_pt: Organize as mesmas palavras nos grupos corretos.
steps.teacher_action: Point out that words can be grouped by use in a sketch description.

expected_output.description_en: One saved matching and sorting set with explicit answer pairs and category targets.
expected_output.description_pt: Um conjunto salvo de relacao e organizacao com pares de resposta explicitos e categorias definidas.

completion_criteria_en: The student matches the visible English and Portuguese terms correctly.
The student sorts the terms into the correct sketch-description groups.
The student keeps the task as matching and sorting, not free writing.
completion_criteria_pt: O aluno relaciona corretamente os termos visiveis em ingles e portugues.
O aluno organiza os termos nos grupos corretos de descricao de croqui.
O aluno mantem a tarefa como relacao e organizacao, nao como escrita livre.
checklist_en: I matched the English and Portuguese support words.
I sorted the words into the category groups.
I checked the category names before I submitted.
checklist_pt: Eu relacionei as palavras em ingles e o apoio em portugues.
Eu organizei as palavras nos grupos de categoria.
Eu conferi os nomes das categorias antes de enviar.
assessment.model_response_en: sketch-croqui, figure-figura, jacket-jaqueta, neckline-decote, color palette-paleta de cores, silhouette-silhueta, denim-denim, main feature-detalhe principal; dress and skirt are garment words; zipper and buttons are detail words.
assessment.model_response_pt: sketch-croqui, figure-figura, jacket-jaqueta, neckline-decote, color palette-paleta de cores, silhouette-silhueta, denim-denim, main feature-detalhe principal; dress e skirt sao palavras de roupa; zipper e buttons sao palavras de detalhe.
common_errors: Putting color words in the fabric group.
Treating silhouette like a garment name.
feedback_prompts_en: Check the word again. Does it name a garment, a detail, a color idea, a fabric, or a design comment?
feedback_prompts_pt: Confira a palavra novamente. Ela nomeia uma roupa, um detalhe, uma ideia de cor, um tecido ou um comentario de design?

support: Let students complete the translation matching before the category sorting.
challenge: Ask stronger learners to say one extra sentence using a sorted word.

extension_options: Name one more word for each category without using the matching list.
activities.notes_for_app_design: Primary saved output is matching. Render a translation-match set first and a category-sort screen second. Display the student-facing EN/PT category labels while saving and checking the stable category keys only. Save explicit pairs and category placements only.

activities.title: Read: Three Sketch Descriptions
activities.summary: Students read three short sketch descriptions, match them to image A to image C, and answer detail questions using visible gallery keys.

en.title: Read: Three Sketch Descriptions
en.summary: Read the short descriptions and choose the correct image or detail answer.
en.instructions: Look at image A to image C first. Read the three short descriptions. Match each text to the correct image and answer the detail questions.
success_criteria: I can connect a short text to the correct sketch.
I can use visible image keys while I read.
I can notice garment, color, and detail words in a model description.

pt.title: Leitura: tres descricoes de croquis
pt.summary: Leia as descricoes curtas e escolha a imagem ou o detalhe correto.
pt.instructions: Observe primeiro as imagens A a C. Leia as tres descricoes curtas. Relacione cada texto a imagem correta e responda as perguntas de detalhe.
success_criteria: Eu consigo ligar um texto curto ao croqui correto.
Eu consigo usar as chaves visiveis das imagens durante a leitura.
Eu consigo perceber palavras de roupa, cor e detalhe em uma descricao modelo.

activities.teacher_instructions: Keep image A to image C visible during the whole task so students can match text to image keys directly.
materials: keyed reading gallery image A to image C

input.prompt_en: Read the texts and choose the correct image key or detail answer.
input.prompt_pt: Leia os textos e escolha a chave da imagem ou a resposta correta sobre detalhe.

items.label_pt: Leia as tres descricoes modelo.
passages_en: Text 1: The figure is wearing a short denim jacket over a white top. The pants are black and straight. The jacket has buttons and two pockets.
Text 2: This sketch shows a long soft blue dress. It has short sleeves and a round neckline. The overall look is calm and elegant.
Text 3: The figure is wearing a cropped yellow top and wide pink pants. The pants have large pockets. The color palette is bright and playful.
passages_pt: Texto 1: The figure is wearing a short denim jacket over a white top. The pants are black and straight. The jacket has buttons and two pockets.
Texto 2: This sketch shows a long soft blue dress. It has short sleeves and a round neckline. The overall look is calm and elegant.
Texto 3: The figure is wearing a cropped yellow top and wide pink pants. The pants have large pockets. The color palette is bright and playful.

items.label_pt: Qual imagem combina com o Texto 1?
Qual imagem combina com o Texto 2?
Qual imagem combina com o Texto 3?

items.label_en: Which image has a round neckline?
items.label_pt: Qual imagem tem um decote redondo?

items.label_en: Which image has large pockets on the pants?
items.label_pt: Qual imagem tem bolsos grandes na calca?

steps.title: Look at the gallery first
steps.student_action_en: Look at image A to image C before you read.
steps.student_action_pt: Observe as imagens A a C antes de ler.

steps.title: Read the three texts

steps.student_action_pt: Leia com atencao as tres descricoes modelo.
steps.teacher_action: Encourage students to underline garment and detail clues.

steps.title: Choose the image and detail answers
steps.student_action_en: Match each text to an image and answer the detail questions.
steps.student_action_pt: Relacione cada texto a uma imagem e responda as perguntas de detalhe.
steps.teacher_action: Remind students to use the image keys, not guess from memory.

expected_output.description_en: Five app-checked reading selections tied to image A to image C and short model texts.
expected_output.description_pt: Cinco selecoes de leitura verificadas pelo app ligadas as imagens A a C e a textos modelo curtos.

completion_criteria_en: The student matches all three texts to the correct image keys.
The student answers the visible detail questions correctly.
The student uses the gallery and text wording together.
completion_criteria_pt: O aluno relaciona os tres textos as chaves de imagem corretas.
O aluno responde corretamente as perguntas visiveis de detalhe.
O aluno usa a galeria e o texto juntos.
checklist_en: I looked at image A to image C first.
I matched each text to one image.
I checked the detail words in the text before I answered.
checklist_pt: Eu observei as imagens A a C primeiro.
Eu relacionei cada texto a uma imagem.
Eu conferi as palavras de detalhe no texto antes de responder.
assessment.model_response_en: Text 1-image A, Text 2-image B, Text 3-image C, round neckline-image B, large pockets-image C
assessment.model_response_pt: Text 1-image A, Text 2-image B, Text 3-image C, round neckline-image B, large pockets-image C

feedback_prompts_en: Read the garment and detail clues again. Which image shows that exact combination?

challenge: Ask stronger learners to say one extra comparison sentence.

extension_options: Say which description is your favorite and why in one short sentence.
activities.notes_for_app_design: Show one stable gallery with visible image A to image C keys and a text panel with three model descriptions. Save six selections only.

activities.title: Listen: Which Sketch Is It?
activities.summary: Students listen to four numbered sketch descriptions and answer image-key and detail questions that align exactly with the Week 10 listening script.

en.title: Listen: Which Sketch Is It?
en.summary: Listen to the numbered descriptions and choose the correct image or detail answer.
en.instructions: Look at image A to image D before the audio starts. Listen to the four numbered descriptions. Choose the correct image or detail answer for each question. Replay is allowed.
success_criteria: I can connect a short audio description to a visible sketch key.
I can listen for garment, detail, and silhouette clues.
I can answer the questions using exact information from the audio.

pt.title: Escuta: qual croqui e esse?
pt.summary: Escute as descricoes numeradas e escolha a imagem ou o detalhe correto.
pt.instructions: Observe as imagens A a D antes de o audio comecar. Escute as quatro descricoes numeradas. Escolha a imagem ou o detalhe correto para cada pergunta. Voce pode ouvir novamente.
success_criteria: Eu consigo ligar uma descricao curta em audio a uma chave visivel de croqui.
Eu consigo escutar pistas de roupa, detalhe e silhueta.
Eu consigo responder usando informacao exata do audio.

activities.teacher_instructions: This activity must stay tightly aligned to the Week 10 listening script. Keep transcript reveal for after the first attempt only.
materials: Week 10 listening gallery image A to image D

input.prompt_en: Listen to the numbered sketch descriptions and choose the correct image key or detail answer.
input.prompt_pt: Escute as descricoes numeradas do croqui e escolha a chave da imagem ou a resposta correta sobre detalhe.

items.label_pt: Qual imagem combina com o numero um?

items.label_en: Which image shows the long green dress from number two?
items.label_pt: Qual imagem mostra o vestido verde longo do numero dois?

items.label_en: What detail is named in number one?
items.label_pt: Qual detalhe e citado no numero um?
options_pt: um decote em V e pregas

items.label_en: Which image has a soft and warm color palette in number three?
items.label_pt: Qual imagem tem uma paleta de cores suave e quente no numero tres?

items.label_en: Which look is described as bright streetwear in number four?
items.label_pt: Qual look e descrito como streetwear vibrante no numero quatro?

steps.title: Look at the gallery before the audio
steps.student_action_en: Look at image A to image D before you press play.
steps.student_action_pt: Observe as imagens A a D antes de iniciar o audio.
steps.teacher_action: Make sure the visible image keys stay on screen.

steps.title: Listen for the four descriptions
steps.student_action_en: Listen once for the four numbered sketch descriptions.
steps.student_action_pt: Escute uma vez as quatro descricoes numeradas do croqui.
steps.teacher_action: Set a clear purpose before the first play.

steps.title: Replay and choose answers
steps.student_action_en: Replay the audio if needed and choose the image and detail answers.
steps.student_action_pt: Ouca novamente se necessario e escolha as respostas de imagem e detalhe.
steps.teacher_action: Allow replay, but keep the first attempt before any script reveal.

expected_output.description_en: Five app-checked listening selections aligned to one numbered sketch-description audio and image A to image D.
expected_output.description_pt: Cinco selecoes de escuta verificadas pelo app alinhadas a um audio numerado de descricao de croqui e as imagens A a D.

completion_criteria_en: The student uses the audio and visible image keys together.
The student answers the image and detail questions with exact information from the script.
The student completes the task without needing hidden teacher judgment.
completion_criteria_pt: O aluno usa o audio e as chaves visiveis das imagens juntos.
O aluno responde as perguntas de imagem e detalhe com informacao exata do roteiro.

checklist_en: I looked at image A to image D before listening.
I used the numbered descriptions to choose the answers.
I replayed the audio only if I needed more detail.
checklist_pt: Eu observei as imagens A a D antes de escutar.
Eu usei as descricoes numeradas para escolher as respostas.
Eu ouvi novamente apenas se precisei de mais detalhe.
assessment.model_response_en: number one-image A; number two-image B; number one detail-a zipper and two pockets; soft and warm palette-image C; bright streetwear-image D
assessment.model_response_pt: number one-image A; number two-image B; number one detail-a zipper and two pockets; soft and warm palette-image C; bright streetwear-image D
common_errors: Choosing image B for number one because both are front views.
Forgetting that pleats belong to number three, not number two.
feedback_prompts_en: Listen again for the exact garment and detail words. Which image key matches those words?
feedback_prompts_pt: Escute novamente as palavras exatas de roupa e detalhe. Qual chave de imagem combina com essas palavras?

support: Pause briefly between descriptions if students need processing time.
challenge: Ask stronger learners to say one extra sentence about a chosen image after the listening task.

extension_options: Say which numbered description was easiest to understand and why.
activities.notes_for_app_design: Render a keyed gallery and one audio player together. Save five selections only. Allow replay. Reveal the script only after the first completed attempt.

activities.title: Organize the Description
activities.summary: Students organize six scrambled description lines into a logical order and then answer two short support questions about the opening and final sentence roles.

en.title: Organize the Description
en.summary: Put the description lines in the best order.
en.instructions: Read the six scrambled lines. Put them in a logical order to build one clear sketch description. Then answer the two short support questions.
success_criteria: I can organize a simple description in a logical order.
I can identify a good opening sentence.
I can identify a good final sentence.

pt.title: Organize a descricao
pt.summary: Coloque as linhas da descricao na melhor ordem.
pt.instructions: Leia as seis linhas embaralhadas. Coloque-as em uma ordem logica para construir uma descricao clara do croqui. Depois responda as duas perguntas curtas de apoio.
success_criteria: Eu consigo organizar uma descricao simples em ordem logica.
Eu consigo identificar uma boa frase de abertura.
Eu consigo identificar uma boa frase final.

activities.teacher_instructions: The main saved output is the ordering sequence. Keep the support questions secondary.

activities.notes_for_app_design: Render the m01w10-img-002 gallery with stable literal keys image A, image B, and image C. Require the student to select one sketch key before completing the writing card, and save that selected sketch key with the structured_text submission. Save the six required line fields separately and keep the optional challenge line visible but not required for completion. Show the selected sketch key and the related gallery image to the teacher during review. In the review view, show the teacher checklist, common-error shortcuts, and feedback prompts, and support return-for-revision on one specific line or one specific missing required element. Do not use a paragraph box and do not use any word-count requirement.

activities.title: Review and Improve: Clear Sketch Description Sentences
activities.summary: Students rewrite two incorrect sketch-description sentences so the language becomes clear, grammatical, and easy to understand.

en.title: Review and Improve: Clear Sketch Description Sentences
en.summary: Rewrite each incorrect sentence so it is clear and correct.
en.instructions: Read one correction card at a time. Rewrite each incorrect sentence so it becomes a correct sketch-description sentence.
success_criteria: I can notice short grammar problems in sketch-description sentences.
I can rewrite the sentence clearly.
I can use the correct simple form without extra ideas.

pt.title: Revise e melhore: frases claras para descrever croquis
pt.summary: Reescreva cada frase incorreta para que fique clara e correta.
pt.instructions: Leia um cartao de correcao por vez. Reescreva cada frase incorreta para que ela se torne uma frase correta de descricao de croqui.
